answer: Each identity must hold a mobile phone contract, opened with a carrier credit check and a monthly bill of about $20 per fake. A farm needs a distinct contract per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost $20,000 every month plus a credit check each. The willow of cheap aliases bends under the bill: every fake adds another contract, the island of the carrier register exposes shared documents, and the zenith of scale is unreachable without real subscribers.
